answer: A reputation spiral defends an agent economy against Sybil attacks: new identities start with zero weight and must earn trust by completing small, peer-verified jobs before they can vote or claim rewards. A fake agent that wanders in fresh cannot skip the climb - each level demands real, checkable work, and bad behavior resets the spiral to zero. By the dawn of every epoch, idle clones decay further, so running a thousand sockpuppets means paying for a thousand honest work histories, which costs far more than the rewards they could steal.
